item.title: Ho-Chunk sculptor Truman Lowe honored in Smithsonian retrospective
item.description: A new exhibit at the Smithsonian’s National Museum of the American Indian looks back on the career of the late Truman Lowe, a Ho-Chunk artist and educator known for his ability to make wood look like water. The post Ho-Chunk sculptor Truman Lowe honored in Smithsonian retrospective appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Essential household costs are driving Wisconsin’s affordability challenge, report says
item.description: While median wages in Wisconsin have kept pace with inflation over the last 25 years, many essential household costs have risen much faster than wages and overall inflation. The post Essential household costs are driving Wisconsin’s affordability challenge, report says appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Merger of cultural, resource centers at UW-Milwaukee leaves some students, faculty concerned
item.description: UW-Milwaukee is consolidating several student cultural and resource centers into a new “unified, student-focused hub.” That's leaving some students worried about access. The post Merger of cultural, resource centers at UW-Milwaukee leaves some students, faculty concerned appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Lawmakers at odds about funding WisconsinEye, putting its future in question
item.description: Time is running out for efforts to keep WisconsinEye — Wisconsin's version of C-SPAN — on the air. The post Lawmakers at odds about funding WisconsinEye, putting its future in question appeared first on WPR.

item.title: New measles case identified in out-of-state traveler who visited Madison
item.description: A traveler from out of state stopped in Madison on Friday, Feb. 6 and later tested positive for measles, according to officials at Public Health Madison & Dane County. The post New measles case identified in out-of-state traveler who visited Madison appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Transcripts: Kenosha DA said he used AI for research before judge sanctioned him
item.description: Kenosha County Xavier Solis admitted he used artificial intelligence for "research" before he was reprimanded by a judge earlier this month over his AI use, newly released court transcripts reveal. The post Transcripts: Kenosha DA said he used AI for research before judge sanctioned him appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Judge finds Muskego man who wrote ‘Jan. 6’ on sidewalk not guilty of disorderly conduct
item.description: A Muskego man has been found not guilty of disorderly conduct after he wrote "Remember Jan. 6" on the sidewalk outside of his local post office last year. The post Judge finds Muskego man who wrote ‘Jan. 6’ on sidewalk not guilty of disorderly conduct appeared first on WPR.

item.title: ‘Only in Wisconsin’: Lake Winnebago’s first legal bar opens for sturgeon spearing season
item.description: A Wisconsin bar is giving new meaning to serving drinks on ice. The post ‘Only in Wisconsin’: Lake Winnebago’s first legal bar opens for sturgeon spearing season appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin musicians celebrate Grammy win for chamber orchestra performance
item.description: Michael Clayville and Erin Lesser of Appleton attended the ceremony in LA, where their group Alarm Will Sound won for their recording of Donnacha Dennehy’s “Land of Winter.” The post Wisconsin musicians celebrate Grammy win for chamber orchestra performance appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Marquette University accused of pushing lower-income families toward risky loans
item.description: Marquette was one of 41 colleges named in a recent report that alleges the schools encourage low-income families to take out Parent PLUS loans while they at the same time offer financial aid to upper-income students. The post Marquette University accused of pushing lower-income families toward risky loans appeared first on WPR.
